newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LOMBARDO'S PALACE MOVE BACK ON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOMBARDO'S PALACE MOVE BACK ON.

text.p: Attilio Lombardo's move to Crystal Palace was back on again on Thursday a week after it looked to be dead.
The Juventus winger was expected to fly into London later in the day to reopen talks with the premier league club's officials.
Transfer talks collapsed last week over the 31-year-old's wage demands but manager Steve Coppell said there was a misunderstanding over net and gross pay.
He said: "The Italians have been back on to us, wanting to bend a little our way.
"I think we're closer to something we can handle."
